usage: As a noun, '攀石' refers to the activity or sport of rock climbing.
You can use '攀石' to talk about the sport in general or a specific session or event of rock climbing.
'攀石' can be combined with verbs like '做' (do), '學' (learn), or '去' (go) to describe engaging in rock climbing.
When using '攀石' in a sentence, it often acts as the object of the verb describing action related to the sport.
